headline: Mexican peso loses 25 centavos against the dollar; closes at 19.42 units
summary: The peso hit its weakest level in 16 months and closed at 19.42 per dollar, despite a retreat in the dollar. Expectations of a narrower interest rate gap with the United States weighed on the currency.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency and is sensitive to interest rate differentials with the US, which affect carry trades and foreign investment flows.
why_moved: Expectations of a smaller interest rate differential with the United States reduced the peso's appeal, even as the dollar retreated.
original_headline: Peso mexicano pierde 25 centavos frente al dólar; cierra en 19.42 unidades
